---
title: "Type I Error"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
devtools::load_all()
results <- read_csv("../data/results.csv")

method_colors <- c(
  "z.test.gaussian" = "#E41A1C",
  "z.test.kappa"    = "#377EB8",
  "bs.multiplier"   = "#4DAF4A",
  "bs.parametric"   = "#FF7F00"
)
```

## Z-Test: Gaussian vs. Kappa

We compare `z.test.gaussian` and `z.test.kappa` at $r = 0$, $p = 2$, across sample sizes, scenarios, and error distributions.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
dat <- results |>
  filter(p == 2, r == 0, method %in% c("z.test.gaussian", "z.test.kappa"), metric == "power") |>
  filter(scenario == 1 | (scenario == 2 & scenario_params == "{\\L\\:[4]}")) |>
  mutate(
    err_type = factor(err_type, levels = c("normal", "exponential")),
    method   = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors))
  )

y_range <- range(dat$metric_val)

plots <- dat |>
  group_by(err_type) |>
  group_map(\(d, g) {
    ggplot(d, aes(x = n, y = metric_val, color = method)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.10, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
      geom_line() +
      geom_point() +
      facet_wrap(~scenario, labeller = labeller(scenario = c(
        "1" = "No Change Points",
        "2" = "Change Points (L = 4)"
      ))) +
      scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_range) +
      labs(x = "n", y = "Type I Error", color = "Method") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  }) |>
  setNames(levels(dat$err_type))

cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
iwalk(plots, \(plot, err_type) {
  cat(paste0("## ", err_type, "\n\n"))
  print(plot)
  cat("\n\n")
})
cat(":::\n")
```

## Z-Test vs. Bootstrap Methods

We compare all four methods at $r = 0$, $p = 2$, across sample sizes, scenarios, and error distributions.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
dat2 <- results |>
  filter(p == 2, r == 0, method %in% c("z.test.gaussian", "z.test.kappa", "bs.multiplier", "bs.parametric"), metric == "power") |>
  filter(scenario == 1 | (scenario == 2 & scenario_params == "{\\L\\:[4]}")) |>
  mutate(
    err_type = factor(err_type, levels = c("normal", "exponential")),
    method   = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors))
  )

y_range2 <- range(dat2$metric_val)

plots2 <- dat2 |>
  group_by(err_type) |>
  group_map(\(d, g) {
    ggplot(d, aes(x = n, y = metric_val, color = method)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.10, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
      geom_line() +
      geom_point() +
      facet_wrap(~scenario, labeller = labeller(scenario = c(
        "1" = "No Change Points",
        "2" = "Change Points (L = 4)"
      ))) +
      scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_range2) +
      labs(x = "n", y = "Type I Error", color = "Method") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  }) |>
  setNames(levels(dat2$err_type))

cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
iwalk(plots2, \(plot, err_type) {
  cat(paste0("## ", err_type, "\n\n"))
  print(plot)
  cat("\n\n")
})
cat(":::\n")
```
